title: Forrestal flown to Hobe Sound, reported belt suicide attempt

tellings.quote: there, he apparently, we're told, tried to hang himself with his belt.

plain: In 1949, James Forrestal, who had just been Secretary of Defense, is said to have been flown to Hobe Sound, Florida, where, as Richard Dolan puts it, "we're told" he tried to hang himself with his belt. Dolan, a historian of UFOs and government secrecy, tells this to Michels in an episode that suggests Forrestal was killed over what he knew about UFOs. He passes it on as something reported, mentioning a man he names as William Manager. It matters because the story of Forrestal's breakdown is part of how his death was explained.
